verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a public REST API at api.vercel.com, with an SDK, versioned endpoints, rate-limit headers, and scoped access tokens for authentication. A probe confirmed that a machine-readable OpenAPI description is live, and llms.txt tells agents to read the OpenAPI spec and auth docs before calling operations. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of actually driving the platform through the API (the only corroboration is a fetch probe of the spec).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
Automate projects, deployments, domains, and account resources through the Vercel REST API or SDK.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://vercel.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
For REST API calls, read the OpenAPI description and authentication documentation before choosing an operation.
All endpoints live under the URL https://api.vercel.com and follow the REST architecture.
Vercel access tokens authenticate requests to the Vercel REST API and the Vercel CLI on your behalf.
